fullText.simplified:
六、快乐是什么

    这个星期，妈妈非常不快乐。
    小飞每天都找妈妈，他希望妈妈和他在一起。
    姥姥每天都打电话给妈妈，她希望妈妈和小飞在一起。
    小飞的爸爸妈妈也打电话给妈妈，他们希望妈妈和他们的儿子在一起。
    妈妈每天都要学习，要去饭店工作，还要打电话，我觉得妈妈每天都很累。
    他们都不喜欢大北，他们希望妈妈和大北分手。他们觉得妈妈是错的，他们是对的。他们想妈妈听他们的话。
    妈妈已经三天没有好好吃饭了。妈妈已经一个星期没有睡觉了。每天晚上她都在哭。
    我觉得人和我们不一样，人要想的事情真多。我有点儿想饭饭了，不知道他现在在哪儿，怎么样了。饭饭是我的好朋友。以前，我们每天都一起去找吃的东西，找睡觉的地方。那个时候很累，有的时候没有吃的，有的时候很冷，没有地方睡觉，但是我觉得我很快乐。有饭吃，我很快乐；有地方睡觉，我很快乐。妈妈现在有饭吃，有地方睡觉，但是我觉得妈妈不快乐。
fullText.traditional:
六、快樂是什麼

    這個星期，媽媽非常不快樂。
    小飛每天都找媽媽，他希望媽媽和他在一起。
    姥姥每天都打電話給媽媽，她希望媽媽和小飛在一起。
    小飛的爸爸媽媽也打電話給媽媽，他們希望媽媽和他們的兒子在一起。
    媽媽每天都要學習，要去飯店工作，還要打電話，我覺得媽媽每天都很累。
    他們都不喜歡大北，他們希望媽媽和大北分手。他們覺得媽媽是錯的，他們是對的。他們想媽媽聽他們的話。
    媽媽已經三天沒有好好吃飯了。媽媽已經一個星期沒有睡覺了。每天晚上她都在哭。
    我覺得人和我們不一樣，人要想的事情真多。我有點兒想飯飯了，不知道他現在在哪兒，怎麼樣了。飯飯是我的好朋友。以前，我們每天都一起去找吃的東西，找睡覺的地方。那個時候很累，有的時候沒有吃的，有的時候很冷，沒有地方睡覺，但是我覺得我很快樂。有飯吃，我很快樂；有地方睡覺，我很快樂。媽媽現在有飯吃，有地方睡覺，但是我覺得媽媽不快樂。

sentences.english: Little Fei came to look for Mom every day. He hoped that Mom would be with him.

sentences.simplified: 姥姥每天都打电话给妈妈，她希望妈妈和小飞在一起。

sentences.pinyin: lǎo lao měi tiān dōu dǎ diàn huà gěi mā ma tā xī wàng mā ma hé xiǎo fēi zài yì qǐ
sentences.english: Grandma called Mom every day. She hoped that Mom and Little Fei would be together.

sentences.english: Little Fei’s mom and dad also called Mom. They hoped that Mom and their son would be together.

sentences.traditional: 媽媽每天都要學習，要去飯店工作，還要打電話，我覺得媽媽每天都很累。

sentences.english: Every day Mom needed to study, work at the restaurant, and talk on the phone. I thought that Mom was very tired every day.

sentences.simplified: 他们觉得妈妈是错的，他们是对的。他们想妈妈听他们的话。

sentences.english: They thought that Mom was wrong and that they were right. They wanted Mom to listen to them.

sentences.english: I started to miss Fanfan a little. I didn’t know where he was or how he was.

sentences.traditional: 飯飯是我的好朋友。以前，我們每天都一起去找吃的東西，找睡覺的地方。

sentences.english: Fanfan is my good friend. Before, every day we would find food to eat and places to sleep together.

sentences.english: Those days were very tiring. Sometimes there was nothing to eat, sometimes it was very cold, and there was nowhere to sleep.

sentences.simplified: 但是我觉得我很快乐。有饭吃，我很快乐；有地方睡觉，我很快乐。
sentences.traditional: 但是我覺得我很快樂。有飯吃，我很快樂；有地方睡覺，我很快樂。

sentences.english: But I feel very happy. With food to eat, I am very happy. With a place to sleep, I am very happy.

sentences.simplified: 妈妈现在有饭吃，有地方睡觉，但是我觉得妈妈不快乐。

sentence_translations: This week, Mom was very unhappy.
Little Fei came to look for Mom every day. He hoped that Mom would be with him.
Grandma called Mom every day. She hoped that Mom and Little Fei would be together.
Little Fei’s mom and dad also called Mom. They hoped that Mom and their son would be together.
Every day Mom needed to study, work at the restaurant, and talk on the phone. I thought that Mom was very tired every day.
They didn’t like Dabei. They hoped that Mom and Dabei would break up.
They thought that Mom was wrong and that they were right. They wanted Mom to listen to them.
Mom had not eaten properly for three days. Mom had not slept for a week. Every night, she would cry.
I think that people are different from us. People really have a lot of things to think about.
I started to miss Fanfan a little. I didn’t know where he was or how he was.
Fanfan is my good friend. Before, every day we would find food to eat and places to sleep together.
Those days were very tiring. Sometimes there was nothing to eat, sometimes it was very cold, and there was nowhere to sleep.
But I feel very happy. With food to eat, I am very happy. With a place to sleep, I am very happy.
Mom now has food to eat and a place to sleep, but I think that Mom isn’t happy.
